description: Replace the raster Air Quality heatmap with a deck.gl ScatterplotLayer of REAL sampled air-quality points over the Google roadmap, and gate ALL air fetching strictly on AQI/PM2.5 pill activation (no air/weather/pollen/forecast/solar fetch on type or place-select). Implements Option B (client-side throttled + cached grid) from RESEARCH-deckgl-sampling-architecture.md. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: REMOVE the raster heatmap overlay effect in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx (the useEffect at ~line 1290 that creates `new w.google.maps.ImageMapType({... getTileUrl: .../mapTypes/${mapType}/heatmapTiles/...})` and pushes it onto map.overlayMapTypes). Remove the HEATMAP_OPACITY const (~line 56) and the now-stale heatmap-tile comments. No code path may reference ImageMapType or /heatmapTiles/ after this.

Add a deck.gl overlay module. Import GoogleMapsOverlay from '@deck.gl/google-maps' and ScatterplotLayer from '@deck.gl/layers' DYNAMICALLY inside the effect (await import(...)) so they stay out of the SSR/initial bundle and so honest-degradation (no key) never loads them. Hold the overlay instance in a ref (e.g. deckOverlayRef) created lazily and attached to the Google map via overlay.setMap(map).

Implement the real-sample grid fetch (Option B). On layer activation (layer === 'AQI' | 'PM25' and a map/place exist), build a responsive grid of lat/lng offsets around place.{lat,lng}: default 5x5 on wide viewports, reduce to 3x3 on narrow (e.g. window.innerWidth < 640), hard cap total points <= 25. Choose a small lat/lng span appropriate to zoom 14 (e.g. +/- ~0.03-0.05 deg) so dots spread visibly around the marker but stay local. Fetch each grid point via POST https://airquality.googleapis.com/v1/currentConditions:lookup?key=${encodeURIComponent(MAPS_KEY)} with the same body shape the existing fetchAir uses (location.latitude/longitude, extraComputations incl. LOCAL_AQI + POLLUTANT_CONCENTRATION, universalAqi:true). Throttle concurrency (<=4 in flight). Parse each response row with the EXISTING airPointFromApi helper (reuse it; for PM2.5 use the point's pm25 field, for AQI use aqi). Drop any point that fails to parse - never fabricate a value.

Cache the grid results in a useRef keyed by `${lat.toFixed(3)},${lng.toFixed(3)}|${gridSize}|${layer}|${timeBucket}` where timeBucket = Math.floor(Date.now()/ (10*60*1000)). Re-activating the same layer on the same place within the bucket reuses the cache and fires zero network calls. Optionally mirror to localStorage with the same key for cross-reload reuse (guard for availability; silent on failure).

Render the points as a ScatterplotLayer: position = [lng, lat], radius encodes severity (and/or a fixed pixel radius with getLineWidth outline), getFillColor = the VayuLok NO-RED severity palette as RGBA. Map each point's severity band (reuse aqiCategory(point.aqi).sev for AQI, and for PM2.5 derive a band from pm25 using the existing severity logic) to the ramp: good #1a3a2a, sat #3da35a, mod #d1f470, poor #e8c547, worst #c98a2e (convert hex to [r,g,b,alpha]). DO NOT use Google's UAQI_RED_GREEN colors. Give dots a dark-green outline (getLineColor ~ [26,58,42]) so they read against light roads; keep radius modest so roads/labels/marker stay visible between dots. Use pickable:false (decorative-but-real; no tooltips required).

Wire the overlay lifecycle to `layer`: when layer becomes non-null, fetch (or read cache) and set the overlay's layers to [new ScatterplotLayer(...)] then overlay.setMap(map). When layer becomes null (or on unmount), clear: overlay.setMap(null) and/or overlay.setProps({layers:[]}) and abort any in-flight grid fetch via an AbortController stored in a ref. Ensure the overlay is created only after the Google map exists (mapRef.current) and only when MAPS_KEY is present. The GoogleMapsOverlay must not cover the Google logo/.gm-style-cc - deck.gl renders in the map's WebGL context and does not add covering DOM, but do not add any container that overlaps the bottom-corner attribution.

GATE THE SINGLE-POINT AIR RESULT ON LAYER TOO. Rework the data-loading so selecting a place does NOT auto-fetch Air/Weather/Pollen/forecast/history/solar. Concretely: the effect currently keyed on [place, refreshNonce] (~line 836) that calls fetchAir/fetchWeather/fetchPollen must NO LONGER fire merely on place change. The LEFT-card AQI/PM2.5 result block already renders only when `layer && air`, so the single-point `air` state (used for the result block AND reusable as the center sample) must be populated as part of the layer-activation flow - e.g. fetch the center point's currentConditions when a layer activates (it can be the grid's center cell, reused so you do not double-fetch), setAir(centerResult). Keep AbortController + Number.isFinite guards + silent degradation + per-place/time cache. Do NOT remove the weather/pollen/forecast CODE wholesale if other sections render it, BUT ensure none of weather/pollen/forecast/history/solar is fetched as a side effect of typing or selecting a place; if those sections are no longer reachable without those fetches, gate their fetches behind an explicit user action or remove the now-dead sections - keep the page coherent and the left card sensible. Preserve honest degradation: no key => zero fetches of any kind.

Confirm honest degradation end to end: with no MAPS_KEY, no map is built, deck.gl is never dynamically imported, no grid/air fetch fires, and the left card still renders place name/address with no spinner/placeholder.

Update src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx for the new behavior: (a) replace the FakeImageMapType-based assertions - the raster path is GONE, so assert NO ImageMapType is constructed and NO fetch URL contains '/heatmapTiles/' at any time. (b) Provide a stub/mocks for the deck.gl dynamic imports (vi.mock('@deck.gl/google-maps', ...) returning a fake GoogleMapsOverlay class that records setMap/setProps calls; vi.mock('@deck.gl/layers', ...) returning a fake ScatterplotLayer that records its props). (c) Assert: on load NO air fetch and NO deck overlay setMap(map); on AQI pill click the deck overlay is attached (setMap called with the map) AND airquality currentConditions:lookup fetches fire (the grid) AND the ScatterplotLayer receives points with no-red fill colors (assert no [255,0,0]-style red fill); on clicking the pill again (layer->null) the overlay is cleared (setMap(null) or layers:[]). (d) Assert typing/selecting a place alone fires NO airquality/weather/pollen fetch. Keep the existing geocoding-import test (seedNamespaceGeocoder:false) and honest-degradation test green. Keep tests behavioral (would fail if the behavior were reverted), not snapshot-brittle.
acceptance_criteria: No reference to ImageMapType, HEATMAP_OPACITY, or /heatmapTiles/ remains in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx (grep returns nothing).
deck.gl GoogleMapsOverlay + ScatterplotLayer are imported dynamically and the overlay is attached to the Google map only when a layer is active and a key is present.
Air-quality grid points are fetched from currentConditions:lookup, parsed via airPointFromApi, cached by area+grid+layer+time-bucket, concurrency-throttled, and abortable; no value is fabricated.
Dot fill colors come from the VayuLok no-red ramp (good #1a3a2a / sat #3da35a / mod #d1f470 / poor #e8c547 / worst #c98a2e); no red is used.
Typing or selecting a place fires ZERO air/weather/pollen/forecast/history/solar network calls; air (and the dot grid) fetch ONLY on AQI/PM2.5 pill activation.
With no key: no map, no deck.gl import, zero fetches; left card still renders name/address with no spinner/placeholder.

src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx asserts: no ImageMapType/heatmapTiles ever; overlay attaches on layer click and clears on deactivate; grid air fetch only on layer click; no air/weather/pollen fetch on type/select; dot colors are no-red; geocoding-import + honest-degradation tests stay green.
